comment: The shared Adagrad recipe removes optimizer progress as a differentiator (Δ≈0.096). B’s three LayerNorm blocks versus one in A and C was the main discriminator, consistent with K1006’s low-progress univariate regression preference. K1008 supported B’s LeakyReLU over C’s GELU, while K1016 discouraged treating C’s extra width as decisive. A’s residual connections did not justify overriding B’s normalization advantage. This result supports existing scoped evidence; it does not isolate normalization from residual status or establish a new rule.
